semantics.capture: On every positive edge of clk, q captures the current d vector using nonblocking sequential assignment.
semantics.hold: q holds its captured value between positive clock edges, including negative edges and input changes.
semantics.reset: No reset port or reset behavior.
semantics.initialization: Initial q is unspecified; no initialization is implemented.
semantics.throughput: One vector captured at every rising edge; no enable or handshake.

numeric.representation: Eight uninterpreted bits with bitwise identity q[i] = sampled d[i] for i=0..7.
numeric.arithmetic: None; no rounding, truncation, extension, saturation or overflow.

verification.oracle: Compare q after each rising edge against d sampled for that edge; check retained q after d changes and falling edges.
verification.coverage: All 256 binary input vectors, followed by representative X/Z vectors to check four-state bit storage in simulation.
verification.initial_state: Do not assert any initial q value before the first rising edge.
verification.execution: Independent self-checking dev_tb top, Icarus -g2012 with explicit top and finite compile/simulation timeouts.
verification.static_review: Exact ports and widths, single positive-edge sequential block, nonblocking assignment, no reset, enable or initialization.
